chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Is'haq ibn 'Ammar, from Abu Baseer, and Safwan, from Mansur ibn Hazim, all of them, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
He said: 'Peleing the Jamarah is from the emergence of the sun until its setting.'

key_terms.رَمْيُ الْجِمَارِ: Peleing the Jamarah (ritual throwing of stones)

ai.seo_question: What is the valid time period for pelting the Jamarah during Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the temporal validity of pelting the Jamarah during the days of Tashreeq, affirming that the ritual may be performed from sunrise until sunset. In Shia jurisprudence, this establishes the permissibility of delaying the act until the end of the day, distinguishing it from the stricter timing required for the Day of Arafah, thereby offering flexibility for pilgrims.
